description: Who calls a class, method or function, or what it calls, to a depth of up to 3 — each use with its file and line. Uses linked only by the bare name are counted, not listed, because they are often a different symbol of the same name. When several symbols share the name, the answer lists them to choose from.

direction.description: 'callers' (who uses it, the default) or 'callees' (what it uses).

path.description: The path of the symbol's file, or part of it, when its name is not enough.

repo.description: Which repository, as 'group/repo'. Omit to ask every repository open here.

symbol.description: The symbol, e.g. 'IssueTransition.MoveAsync'. A bare name works when only one symbol has it.

name: code_calls
